v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce quam bonum * et quam iucúndum habitáre fratres in unum. ‡
text.en: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. ‡

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for he was mindful of us in our affliction.

text.la: Adhǽreat lingua mea * fáucibus meis, si non memínero tui Ierúsalem.
text.en: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws * if I do not remember thee, Jerusalem.

text.la: Confitébor * nómini tuo, Dómine, super misericórdia et veritáte tua.
text.en: I will give glory * to thy name, for thy mercy, and for thy truth.

text.la: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
text.en: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

text.la: Prima stropha sequentis hymni dicitur flexis genibus.
text.en: The first verse of the following hymn is said genuflecting.

v.la: Dignáre me laudáre te, Virgo sacráta.
v.en: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be.

r.la: Da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
r.en: Give me strength against thine enemies.

text.la: Beátam me dicent * omnes generatiónes, quia ancíllam húmilem respéxit Deus.
text.en: All generations shall call me blessed, * for God hath regarded the lowliness of His hand-maiden.

text.la: Concéde nos fámulos tuos, quǽsumus, Dómine Deus, perpétua mentis et córporis sanitáte gaudére: et, gloriósa beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis intercessióne, a præsénti liberári tristítia, et ætérna pérfrui lætítia.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord God, unto all thy servants, that they may remain continually in the enjoyment of soundness both of mind and body, and by the glorious intercession of the Blessed Mary, always a Virgin, may be delivered from present sadness, and enter into the joy of thine eternal gladness.
